units: <cite ref="Chullin 43b:3">Ḥull. 43ᵇ</cite> <he>שחותכו וקווֵֹץ</he> Ar., v. <cite ref="K00361"><he>כְּוֵץ</he></cite>.—Part. pass. <cite ref="S00264"><he>קָווּץ</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Sukkah 32a">Succ. 32ᵃ</cite> top <he>ק׳</he> (<cite ref="L00270"><he>לולב</he></cite>) a Lulab which is shrunk (Rashi: thorn-like, v. <cite ref="S00534"><he>קוֹץ</he></cite>).—V. <cite ref="S00264"><he>קָווּץ</he></cite>.—Denom. <cite ref="S00534"><he>קוֹץ</he></cite>, <cite ref="S01116"><he>קַיִץ</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: (denom. of קוֹץ) to clear of thorns, weed.
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 6a:11">M. Kat. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>יוצאין לקַוֵּוץ וכ׳</he> they go out to clear the roads (for the Passover pilgrims).

<cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 3:7">Tosef. Shebi. III, 7</cite> <he>מְקַוְּצִין וכ׳</he> Var. ed. Zuck. (ed. Zuck. <he>מְקַוְּסִין</he>; oth. ed. <he>מקומין</he>, corr. acc.) you may remove the stones, thorns &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 4:2">Shebi. IV, 2</cite> <he>שדה שנִתְקַוְּצה</he> (Y. ed. <he>שנִתְקַוְּו׳</he>) a field that has been cleared; <cite ref="Bekhorot 34b">Bekh. 34ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Moed Katan 13b">M. Kat. 13ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Gittin 44b">Gitt. 44ᵇ</cite>
